label: Enable remote access
help: Off by default. While off, nothing is sent to or read from Slack.

label: Bot token secret
help: Wallet reference holding the Slack bot token (xoxb-...), never the token itself.

label: Allowed conversation IDs
help: JSON array of channel, private channel or DM IDs, e.g. ["C0123456789", "D0123456789"]. Any other conversation is refused before the wallet is read.

label: Default conversation ID
help: Conversation used when an input gives no channel. It must also be allowed. Leave empty to require channel.

label: Shareable files directory
help: Only regular files inside this directory can be uploaded from the file input. Empty disables uploads.

label: Messages per read
help: Upper bound and default for one read_history or read_replies operation.

label: Operation deadline (s)
help: Total time for one operation, including pages, upload steps and retries after HTTP 429. Ambiguous writes are never retried.

label: Messages per page
help: limit sent to conversations.history and conversations.replies; Slack recommends 200 or fewer.

label: Pages per read
help: A read stops after this many pages and returns next_cursor to continue later.

label: Retries after HTTP 429
help: Only rate-limited calls, which Slack did not process, are retried.

label: Longest retry wait (s)
help: A Retry-After above this value returns a rate_limited error instead of waiting.

label: File size limit (bytes)
help: Upper bound for one uploaded file, from 1 KiB to 100 MiB.

label: Response size limit (bytes)
help: Larger Slack responses are refused as protocol errors.

label: Web API origin
help: Keep https://slack.com. Only a loopback test double (http://127.0.0.1:port) may replace it.

label: Custom CA file
help: Optional absolute PEM file, used only with an HTTPS loopback test double. TLS verification cannot be disabled.
